---
params:
  data_path: ""
  lang: "en"
  subject: ""
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: false
  pdf:
    papersize: a4
  docx: default
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(PhysioReport)
library(ggplot2)
report_key <- "gait_report"
data <- readRDS(params$data_path)
lang <- params$lang
```

```{r title}
#| output: asis
cat("# ", physioLabel(report_key, lang), "\n\n", sep = "")
if (nzchar(params$subject)) {
  cat("**", physioLabel("subject", lang), ":** ", params$subject, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r figures}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
for (nm in names(data$figures)) print(data$figures[[nm]])
```

```{r change-table}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(data$change)) {
  cat("\n\n## ", physioLabel("change", lang), "\n\n", sep = "")
  df <- as.data.frame(data$change)
  keep <- intersect(c("metric", "change", "mdc", "mcid", "classification"),
                    names(df))
  print(knitr::kable(df[, keep, drop = FALSE], row.names = FALSE))
}
```

```{r provenance}
#| output: asis
cat("\n\n---\n\n", PhysioReport:::.report_provenance(data$provenance), "\n",
    sep = "")
```
